title: Fresh beginnings for homepage storytelling

authorization.scope: Implement the proposed changing Start with a story section.

behaviour: Choose one story per slot on page load; remain still until explicit visitor request.
Avoid the last 18 displayed story paths when the pool permits; retain bounded local history only.
Prefer a regional connection between place and taste; add seasonal weighting using the Odisha calendar.
Show me another beginning changes cards and matching footer credits together.
Preserve the three server-rendered fallback cards when scripting is unavailable.
Only curated stories within the current published coastal edition are eligible.

editorial_controls.admission: Add an enabled pool entry referencing a published, illustrated discovery entry with complete credits. Each slot must have an eligible story.
editorial_controls.preferred_months: Optional numeric months 1–12; increase weight, never claim opening hours or festival dates.
editorial_controls.pins: Empty initially. A pin has href, slot, optional starts and mandatory expires (YYYY-MM-DD). Dates are inclusive in Asia/Kolkata. Overlapping pins in a slot fail validation. Expired pins stop applying without a rebuild.

implementation.privacy: Only locally displayed story paths are stored. No account, network tracking or paid backend added. Storage refusal retains in-memory repeat avoidance.
deferred: Matching stories to the hero image

validation.visual_browser_review: Unavailable: administrator-enforced browser security policy could not be verified. No workaround attempted.

publication: Not published by this implementation record. Prepare a reviewable PR; no release recorded.
